name: Summoner Princess Artemina 2 -Tatakae! Apologue-
original_name: サマナープリンセス アルテミナ2 -戦え! アポローグ-
source:
Yuuri went to go visit Arisa for the first time in a whole, but ran into the mysterious Greed instead.
She transforms into Aprog to make a stand, but is defeated and kidnapped by the creature. After endless humiliations, she's revived by Orthrus only to find that everyone in the city has forgotten about Greed... and about Artemina.
Even Arisa has forgotten about Artemina! But Greed's evil clutches grow tighter every day.
Yuuri's lonely battle against the monster begins...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ009537.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
由里前去探望有段时间没见的亚里莎，却遇见了神秘的贪婪。
她变身为阿普罗格挺身而出，却被怪物击败并绑架。遭受无尽屈辱后，她被奥尔特罗斯复活，却发现城里所有人都忘记了贪婪……也忘记了阿尔特米娜。
甚至连亚里莎也忘记了阿尔特米娜！然而，贪婪的邪恶魔爪每天都在收紧。

由里与怪物之间孤独的战斗开始了……
